svg.text: MARS-OPS SYSTEM — COMPLETE STATIC STRUCTURE UML CLASS DIAGRAM

g.text: + Agent(name: String, id: String, loc: String)
UML Relationship Legend & Design Justification (Lab 5 Sections 11.1 & 11.2)
Association: Objects collaborate without ownership (e.g. Mission holds assignedAgents; Colony tracks activeMission).
Aggregation (Hollow Diamond): Whole-part relationship; parts can exist independently (Colony aggregates Agents & Facilities).
Composition (Solid Diamond): Strong ownership; part lifecycle tied to whole (Habitat strictly owns its LifeSupportSystem).
Generalization / Inheritance: 'is-a' hierarchy enabling polymorphism (Agent, Facility, Mission, Emergency hierarchies).
